races.paceDynamic: Made U Blush and Love Sonnet will dispute the early lead, with Made U Blush's stronger pace credentials likely to see her dominate from the front. The massive prominent contingent (La Luna Artista, Only One Blue, The Procrastinator, Queen Maeve, Whitletts, Cloaks Of Gold, Siorai) creates a wall of horses tracking the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems approaching the business end. This honest gallop should see the field string out by halfway, but the lack of genuine hold-up horses means the pace won't collapse. This race shape strongly favours the two confirmed leaders and any prominent runner who can secure a clean passage, as the crowded midfield will struggle for racing room when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Made U Blush or Love Sonnet gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in.
scenarios.body: The winner steals a march on the prominent pack who get in each other's way, maintaining the advantage up the hill. Clean jumping and tactical speed proves decisive over class.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the seven prominent runners bunch up and create interference 3 furlongs out.
scenarios.body: The leaders come back to the field but multiple fallers or hampered horses change the complexion entirely. The least inconvenienced prominent runner emerges from the carnage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If La Luna Artista gets a clear run and produces her best RPR 116 form from the prominent position.
scenarios.body: Her superior recent form (1151) and proven Sandown record sees her reel in the leaders despite the unfavourable pace setup. Quality overcomes tactics in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up, allowing the prominent pack to sweep past.
scenarios.body: Made U Blush and Love Sonnet's long layoffs (84d/70d) tell in the closing stages as fresher legs take over. The race becomes a sprint finish between multiple prominent runners.

watchPoints.text: Made U Blush and Love Sonnet clash early and go too fast, setting up the race for the prominent pack behind
Traffic problems developing 3 furlongs out as seven prominent runners converge on limited racing room

races.paceDynamic: Kocktail Bleu, Cosmic Connection, Desertmore News and Last Round will ensure a strong gallop from the start with four committed front runners in a large field. The pace will be genuinely testing over this 2m trip, particularly with Kocktail Bleu and Cosmic Connection both in good form and likely to dispute the early lead. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and create gaps, putting pressure on those needing to be covered up early. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and strong travellers who can sit in the first half dozen, as hold-up horses will struggle to get into contention from the back of such a large, well-strung field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the front runners but perfectly suit those sitting in touch like Minella Yoga and Kadastral. Prominent racers with tactical pace will pick up the pieces as the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run and the pace is more measured
scenarios.body: Cosmic Connection or Kocktail Bleu could dictate terms if they can steal a march on their pace rivals. The Chris Gordon pair have the class and form to make all if getting an uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for a closer with a devastating turn of foot. Wilstar or Dutch Corner could benefit from a truly-run race that comes back to them late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Muddles Through
scenarios.trigger: If the front runners go steady and tactical positioning becomes key
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair would favour those with tactical speed who can quicken. The race would become more about who gets the clearest run rather than stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Matterhorn and Mahons Glory will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a genuine gallop over this extended trip. The pace should be honest rather than frantic, as both leaders have shown they can sustain their efforts, particularly Matterhorn who has strong Sandown form. This creates a tactical race where the hold-up horses (Blow Your Wad, Etalon, Doyen Quest, Teddy Blue) can time their challenges from off the pace. The race shape strongly favours patient hold-up performers who can capitalise on the sustained gallop and Sandown's testing finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and sustainable between Matterhorn and Mahons Glory
scenarios.body: The leaders will soften each other up over the extended trip, allowing the quartet of hold-up horses to pick them off in the closing stages. Blow Your Wad and Etalon are perfectly positioned to benefit from this scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner gets away
scenarios.trigger: If one of Matterhorn or Mahons Glory gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms and potentially stay on strongly, with Matterhorn's Sandown form making him the more likely beneficiary. The hold-up horses would face a stiffer task trying to reel in a horse that hasn't been pressured early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ventura Highway can get involved early and avoid the pace battle
scenarios.body: The only prominent runner could find himself in the perfect position behind the battling leaders, striking at the ideal moment. However, his long absence and lower rating make this an unlikely outcome despite the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard too early and tie up badly
scenarios.body: The race would become a sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses could prevail, but this seems unlikely given both leaders have shown stamina reserves. Teddy Blue might benefit most from a truly-run affair given his trainer's 14-day form.

races.paceDynamic: Livin On Luco will take them along at a comfortable gallop without pressure, creating a steady rhythm through the early stages. The prominent runners Rock My Way, Road To Home, Our Power and In d'Or will track within striking distance but won't need to battle for position. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses including Resplendent Grey, Henry's Friend, Transmission, Montregard, Havaila and Ask Brewster, the pace will be sustainable rather than fierce. This tactical setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenge late over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The race will develop into a true staying test that suits horses who can travel strongly in behind the leaders. Rock My Way's recent course form and Road To Home's Mullins factor become decisive advantages over a truly-run 3m4½f.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Livin On Luco sets too slow a pace and gets caught napping when the field closes
scenarios.body: The front-runner will find enough to hold on when the challenge comes too late to be sustained. Livin On Luco's stamina reserves prove sufficient against hold-up horses who leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners decide to pressure Livin On Luco from the outset
scenarios.body: An unexpectedly strong pace will set up the race for a horse with tactical speed who can position flexibly. Transmission's recent course win suggests he can adapt to different pace scenarios better than most.

races.paceDynamic: With Joltin N Jiving withdrawn as the sole confirmed front-runner, this race loses its natural pace anchor and becomes tactically uncertain. The prominent runners Authorised Speed, Dargiannini, Royal Way, Fasol, Trustintimes, Gnomon, No Ordinary Joe, Lucky Manifest, and Across Earth will need to fill the vacuum, but none are natural pace-forcers. This creates a messy early scramble before settling into a steady tempo, then a prolonged sprint finish over the final 4-5 furlongs. The lack of genuine pace pressure strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent runners with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack hesitates early and creates stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl before exploding late, suiting horses that can quicken from off the pace. Hold-up specialists with class like Favour And Fortune and tactical pace like Listentoyourheart thrive in sprint finishes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Fasol Takes Control
scenarios.trigger: If Fasol or Trustintimes grab the initiative from the start and maintain honest fractions
scenarios.body: A more conventional race shape emerges with sustainable pace, allowing prominent runners to dictate and kick clear. The Nicholls yard's recent form surge and Trustintimes' winning streak become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into a crawling affair until the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing kick over 2 furlongs, massively favouring class horses held up. Experience jockeys like Harry Skelton and Harry Cobden excel in these tactical battles from the rear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Gnomon Front-Running
scenarios.trigger: If Gnomon or Across Earth unexpectedly go forward to fill the pace void
scenarios.body: An inexperienced pace-setter creates uneven fractions and cracks under pressure in the straight. This opens the door for battle-hardened campaigners to sweep past in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Authorised Speed and Royal Way could be caught cold if they're forced forward early without their preferred pace scenario
Fasol and Trustintimes must avoid getting into an early speed duel that could compromise both of their chances
Surrey Lord and Aurigny Mill need the race to become tactical to showcase their finishing kicks effectively
Across Earth and Gnomon may be reluctantly pushed forward by their jockeys if no other pace emerges
Favour And Fortune requires patient riding from Bellamy to deliver his trademark late charge when the race unfolds
